title: Add CLI pipeline file and artifact handoff contracts

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official Python tempfile, Node fs, OWASP path traversal, and CWE-22 sources were checked.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap and mode selection
phases.bottleneck_notes: Memory bootstrap and governance mode selection were completed before local edits.

phases.label: Requirements and spec records
phases.bottleneck_notes: The task required paired KO/EN requirements, spec, plan, tasks, validation, traceability, research, and history records.

phases.label: Validator, config, docs, and tests
phases.bottleneck_notes: Largest phase because the artifact contract touched validator code, tests, template, docs, workflows, prompts, memory, README, persistent instructions, and CLI adapter registry.

phases.label: Automated verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Unit tests and core config checks were run first; full close-out checks are recorded in evaluation.

phases.label: Evaluation and close-out records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Omission, resource, grounding, evaluator, request trace, and work summary records were created.

bottleneck_notes: The implementation phase is the bottleneck because this is a cross-cutting governance and validator change.
Future similar changes could be faster with a generator for paired KO/EN governance artifacts.
